contract: A native duplex session attaches only to an existing nonterminal experience.07 native call request and never initiates, answers or ends an external call. The fixed paired-desktop operation set captures bounded mono PCM through bundled AVFoundation source, sends the isolated recording through Gideon's configured STT, accepts a bounded agent reply, sends it through Gideon's configured TTS and plays only that returned file through AVFoundation. Durable compare-and-swap session state preserves turns and marks in-flight restart state interrupted/unknown. No client executable, path, hostname or generic host command is accepted.
acceptance: Bundled macOS source requests microphone permission, records 16 kHz mono linear PCM and plays returned audio with AVFoundation. Runtime validates existing call identity, bounded turns/duration/reply, request replay/conflict, fixed helper commands, durable restart recovery, STT/TTS bridge state, unavailable Mac/provider behavior and fixed HTTP actions. Console exposes readiness, attach/capture/speak/stop and retained turn state while stating that external call commands require separate explicit approval. Local checks do not claim Mac device, provider, network or call execution.
remaining_limits: AVFoundation compilation, microphone permission, real capture and real speaker playback require qualification on a paired Mac
Configured STT and TTS providers were not invoked; provider credentials, local models and network availability remain unqualified
The slice attaches to an existing native call request and never dials, answers or hangs up; those external mutations retain experience.07 approval and uncertain-state boundaries
Authenticated paired transport and tenant allocation are hosted integration responsibilities; this source runtime exposes fixed operations for the existing authenticated dashboard boundary
Root must register native_duplex_http in the shared experience handler, render NativeDuplex from the shared Page and enroll the Swift asset in package/native manifests
Live browser and aggregate application integration remain root qualification
